summary: Iter16 tested paid-invoice receipts, the collections forecast and the provider statement on the backend and frontend. New suite test_ledger_receipts_statement.py: 21/21 pass. Mark-paid checks: a future paid_on gives 400; a bad date format gives 400; an unknown mode gives 400; a provider gets 403. With a body, the payment is stored with receipt_no RCPT/<number with ->, amount, amount_words, mode, reference and note. delivery.kind is 'receipt' and crm is true, and a Supabase notifications row of type invoice_receipt is written. A second paid call gives 400 'Invoice already paid'. Void on a paid invoice gives 400. Paid with no body defaults to today and bank_transfer. Receipt PDF: admin, owner and ?token= all return a %PDF. Another provider gets 403 and an unpaid invoice gets 400. Forecast: provider gets 403. There are 30 daily rows and 5 weekly labels as specified; the weekly sum equals upcoming, and expected_total equals upcoming plus overdue. Moving due dates moves invoices into the right day, week and overdue bucket. Paid invoices are excluded. Overdue matches an independent Mongo recompute, and days=14 gives 14 daily rows and 2 weekly buckets. Statement: a provider passing uid gets 403; admin without uid gets 403; a bad date format gives 400. The running balance is correct over 3 invoices and 2 payments. Opening balance with 'from' is correct, the from/to window is respected, providers are isolated, and the PDF works via header and ?token (another provider 403, no auth 401/403). Regression: test_provider_ledger.py + test_ledger_fixes_iter14.py 59/59 pass. test_ledger_billing_addons.py 25/27: the 2 TestLabOnboarding failures are a 500 from an unrelated new bug (see backend_issues). Frontend (Playwright 1920, with token injection): /admin/ledger/revenue Collections forecast works in all 3 views. Weekly shows Overdue ₹2,360 and Next week ₹3,540. Day by day shows the recharts bar chart with a bar on the due date and the overdue line. Total shows ₹5,900, ₹3,540 and ₹2,360, all correct. Admin provider page, Invoices tab: Paid opens the Record payment dialog (defaults today/bank_transfer, max=today), Cancel closes it, and submitting with UPI, a reference and a note toasts 'Marked paid · receipt in CRM · no billing email on file'. The row then flips to Paid with a Receipt button, and the download is RCPT-TH-202609-0001.pdf. Statement tab: the opening, invoiced, paid and due figures and 5 rows are correct. The from/to filters and the 'All time' reset work, and the PDF downloads. Provider /provider/ledger: Receipt buttons appear only on paid invoices and there are no Paid/Void buttons. The provider statement and its PDF work, and there is no horizontal overflow on mobile 390. The receipt, statement and invoice PDFs render the Trata logo header (checked by eye). The email shell uses <app_url>/brand/trata-doc-logo.png, which returns 200 image/png. There were no page errors.

critical.issue: Returns 500 asyncpg AmbiguousParameterError 'inconsistent types deduced for parameter $2' in supabase_db.py create_provider_from_admin, split-lab branch (~line 1386-1395). The path_lab_profiles and diagnostic_centre_profiles split tables now EXIST in production Supabase (varchar id/user_id), so lab_split_live() is True and this previously untested branch runs. $2 is used both as an INSERT value and in 'WHERE user_id = $2' without a cast. Lab onboarding is broken in production. This is not caused by iter16, but it fails 2 tests in test_ledger_billing_addons.py.

minor.issue: paid_on is checked only by regex and string comparison, so impossible dates like '2026-02-30' are accepted (200, stored on the receipt). paid_on before the invoice issue_date is also accepted. Parse it with date.fromisoformat and reject paid_on < issue_date.
An invalid calendar date returns 200, because it is checked by regex only. Parse it with date.fromisoformat.
About 2.6-3.0s per call, because build_statement calls lsb.list_providers() (all providers) just to read one provider's name and city. Fetch the single provider instead.

integration_issues.issue: There is no loading indicator while the statement refetches (about 3s), so the old figures show under the new date range. There is also no stale-response guard (abort or request id), so fast date changes can show results out of order. On mount the statement is fetched twice, because <Statement key={invoices statuses}> remounts after the invoices load.

issues: Uses native <input type=date> (browser default picker) rather than the shadcn Calendar/Popover used elsewhere.

design_issues.screen: Admin provider ledger header (/admin/ledger/{uid}) for probe providers
issues: Header shows 'HOSPITAL · —' and '· fee 10%' with an empty name/city segment (seen with the probe provider, which has no city). This may be an existing issue.

action_items: HIGH: Fix supabase_db.create_provider_from_admin split-lab INSERT: cast $1/$2 (e.g. $2::varchar in both the VALUES and the WHERE NOT EXISTS) and check the branches insert too. Then update TestLabOnboarding in test_ledger_billing_addons.py, which still expects legacy pathologists/labs rows although the split tables are now live.
Validate paid_on as a real date (date.fromisoformat) and not earlier than invoice.issue_date. Validate statement from/to the same way.
Speed up build_statement: avoid lsb.list_providers() for every call.
Statement.jsx: show a loading state on refetch and ignore stale responses. Avoid the double fetch caused by the key remount.
critical_code_review_comments: ledger.py is about 1210 lines and should be split into routers (invoices, receipts/forecast/statement, settings).

Forecast counts 'issued' and 'shared' invoices, but statement only counts 'shared' and 'paid'. This matches the spec, but legacy 'issued' invoices appear in the forecast and not on the provider statement.

The email logo URL uses app_url taken from the admin request Origin. A receipt sent while marking paid from the preview domain links to the preview host's /brand image. Consider a configured PUBLIC_APP_URL env.
receipt_pdf fallback (setdefault payment) handles legacy paid invoices without a payment object. That is good.

success_rate.backend: 98% (105/107; the 2 failures are an unrelated lab-onboarding 500)

seed_data_creation: Only TEST_probe data: probe hospitals 9999900021/22 and TEST_probe promotions/invoices TH/202608..202610/0001 for uid_a. Everything was removed with `ledger_probe_fixtures.py cleanup` (0 invoices and 0 probe promos left in Mongo).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Order: `python ledger_probe_fixtures.py setup`, then null users.email for 9999900021/22, then `pytest test_ledger_receipts_statement.py` (self-contained, about 75s). For UI, run `python ledger_ui_seed_iter16.py` after setup; it writes /tmp/ledger_ui_iter16.json. Inject localStorage trata_token plus trata_user (from /api/auth/me, fetched with python requests, because urllib gets 403 from Cloudflare) and use wait_until=domcontentloaded (networkidle never settles because of polling). Statement API takes about 3s, so wait 5-6s after a date change. ALWAYS run cleanup at the end. Run regression suites against a fresh setup each (test_ledger_billing_addons needs an empty current month).
rca of the issue: Lab onboarding 500: supabase_db.py ~1386 `SELECT $1, $2, ... WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.{tbl} WHERE user_id = $2)`. Postgres deduces $2 as varchar from the INSERT column and as text from the comparison, which is ambiguous in asyncpg prepare. This only shows now because lab_split_live() turned True once the 4 split tables appeared in production Supabase. Fix: add an explicit cast `$2::varchar` (and `$1::varchar`) as the other vertical branches already do with ::text.
